scope: Final bounded extension: Factory Droid and Pi coding agent

hosts.name: Factory Droid

upstream_installer_global_roots.droid: ~/.factory/skills (registered adapter field; universal installation uses shared ~/.agents/skills)

hosts.skill_precedence: Ordinary sessions: folder/project > project plugin > personal > user plugin > builtin. Mission/automation and managed/CLI scopes can supersede this; same-bucket duplicate names are invalid.

project: cwd through git root, each directory plus .factory/ .agents/ .agent/
instructions.precedence: Nested refines root; project overrides personal. These are alternative supported names, not a request to duplicate files.

hosts.format: SKILL.md name/description required. enabled, user-invocable, disable-model-invocation control availability. allowed-tools is metadata, not a sandbox; custom command name collision wins slash invocation.
hosts.extensions: Custom subagents: .factory/droids/*.md or ~/.factory/droids/*.md, Task tool with native tool policy. Hooks: .factory/hooks.json and ~/.factory/hooks.json, settings.json fallback. Plugins separately register skills/commands/droids/hooks/MCP; compatible Claude layouts are translated during cache copy.
limitations: Recursive discovery stops at each SKILL.md directory.
Symlinked .factory/skills discovery documented fixed in CLI0.56.0 (2026-01-27); broken symlinks skipped from CLI0.187.0 (2026-08-04). Shared-root symlink-specific implementation not inspected.
Adapter ID is droid, not factory; skillsDir=.agents/skills marks the pinned adapter universal. No extra ~/.factory copy is required merely because the registered globalSkillsDir names it.
Copying only skills does not register hooks, subagents or native plugins.

hosts.name: Pi coding agent

project: <cwd>/.agents/skills through ancestors to git root, or filesystem root without Git (trusted)

hosts.skill_precedence: First discovered same-name skill wins with collision diagnostic; canonical same-file duplicates skipped. Automatic roots order: trusted cwd .pi, trusted .agents nearest-to-root, user Pi, user .agents. CLI/package/settings resources can precede defaults; this root order is not a universal priority over explicit resources.

project: cwd and all parent directories; no git-root stop for context files
instructions.precedence: First filename per directory; assembled global then filesystem-root-to-cwd context, with linked-worktree shadow suppression. Context does not require project trust. Trusted .pi/SYSTEM.md and .pi/APPEND_SYSTEM.md each replace corresponding global file selection; SYSTEM replaces default prompt.

hosts.format: Missing name falls back to directory; nonempty description required. Malformed or descriptionless declared skill skipped; most name/length errors warn. /skill:name explicitly invokes; disable-model-invocation hides automatic selection. allowed-tools appears as experimental standard metadata in docs; inspected Skill loader does not enforce tool restrictions.
hosts.extensions: Native TypeScript extensions register tools, commands and lifecycle handlers; .pi/extensions and agent-dir/extensions are separate resources. No built-in subagent capability is promised: README delegates this to extensions/packages. A plain skill install does not activate extension code.
limitations: Pinned current source 42a3497d03ad17e308a2299fa824727894f2c0ec under earendil-works/pi; former badlogic/pi-mono redirects. Current package @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, distinguish older @mariozechner releases.

Both package discovery and skill loading stat symlink targets, follow directory/file symlinks and skip broken links. Ignore files and project trust still filter candidates. Source inspection, not full native execution.
Actual resource-loader passes includeDefaults:false into loadSkills; avoid inferring CLI priority from the standalone helper default user-before-project branch.
Pinned installer pi adapter is non-universal and does not honor PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR; overridden native homes need destination verification.
